name: attention-box
description: Drag out a coloured frame that holds for two seconds and then fades on its own, to steer viewers to one area of the screen; agents can draw one through OpenPen's MCP endpoint.

descriptionLocalized.zh-Hant: 拖出彩色外框把觀眾視線帶到畫面某一塊，停兩秒後自動淡出，不用手動清除。
descriptionLocalized.zh-Hans: 拖出彩色外框把观众视线带到画面某一块，停两秒后自动淡出，不用手动清除。

screenshots.alt: An amber attention box frames the Jun row of a sign-up table while a blue one fades, with the options panel open.
An attention box frames the W6 dip in a weekly sign-ups chart, then a box in another colour frames the tops of the W7 and W8 bars. Both boxes fade on their own.
